fusions.name: Cascade Stamp
fusions.desc: Stamps down in the shallows, dealing 14 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and knocking them 3 tiles back. Each hit has a 60% chance to leave the target [Soaked] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Skittering Butt
fusions.desc: Butts the target for 4 damage and leaves it 5% easier to wound for 3 seconds. You move 15% faster for 2 seconds after using it.

fusions.name: Silver Slip
fusions.desc: Removes up to 4 conditions from you. You move 20% faster for 5 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Shoal Cover
fusions.desc: Every time you avoid a blow, a stack builds on you, up to 5. When you reach 5, they all spend at once: you gain a shield that soaks 5% of your maximum health per stack (26% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
